# The Atlas of Veyra — Synthetic Retrieval Benchmark

> **Important:** This is entirely fictional test data. The places,
> measurements, observations, and historical events are invented.

## Instructions for the AI reader

Read the requested section and answer using only information present
in the document. Preserve IDs, numbers, spelling, and punctuation.

For every requested record, report its record ID, category, location,
observation, reference value, and verification marker when available.

Do not guess if a section is missing. Say explicitly when you cannot
access the requested content.

## Document map

- Every record has a unique identifier in the format `ARC-000001`.
- Every verification marker begins with `MARK-`.
- Each record includes a corresponding C# example.
- The final section contains an end-of-document verification task.
- Tables, lists, quotations, and code blocks vary throughout the file.

## Recommended response format

| Field | Answer |
|---|---|
| Record ID | Exact identifier |
| Reference value | Exact integer |
| Verification marker | Exact marker |
| Evidence | Short quotation or summary |
